dedupe_keys.name: new delhi apartment energy feedback experiment data

description: This deposit contains electricity-use records and replication material for an information-feedback experiment in nineteen faculty apartments in New Delhi. UCLA and IIIT collaborators provide apartment characteristics, appliance-related consumption and hourly weather information to support studies of energy-conservation behaviour. The description and article give 1 August 2013–12 May 2014, while structured repository coverage fields end in February 2014; the discrepancy remains unresolved. Dataverse lists Stata data and scripts, tab-separated tables and documentation, free under CC0 1.0. The named metadata API worked, although the HTML page returned an empty HTTP 202 response. Coverage is a small housing complex with an intervention, not a representative Indian household sample. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating occupant-response assumptions or checking household electricity-demand simulations. data-refit-smart-homes-uk offers related appliance monitoring from another setting. File contents, a uniform consumption sampling interval and direct compatibility between datasets were not checked. No records or scripts were downloaded.
